snippet.title: Mega Man X Regenesis | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Get your busters ready... 

Mega Man X Regenesis launches on August 17, 2026!

Set in an alternate timeline following the events of Mega Man X, Sigma has won, X has fallen, and humanity stands on the brink of extinction. Just when all hope appears lost, Dr. Cain unveils his final contingency—Project Regenesis. Given one last chance to rewrite history, X must rise once again and fight to save what remains of humanity.

Features

• An original story set in an alternate Mega Man X timeline
• Eight brand-new Maverick bosses to defeat
• New Special Weapons to master
• Discover powerful Armor Upgrades
• Search for hidden collectibles and secrets
• Unlock in-game Achievements
• Over 25 original soundtrack pieces
• Hand-crafted SNES-inspired pixel art
• Full controller support

Release

Release Date: August 17, 2026

Mega Man X Regenesis will be available as a FREE download on itch.io.

Will be supported on PC, Android and Steam Deck.

Join the Community

Discord: https://discord.gg/HXkRNaSWRV

Join the community to follow development, share feedback, report bugs, discuss strategies, and connect with fellow Mega Man X fans.

Credits

Development-
Justin Ross

Music-
JB Sasserman (John Bonham)
mega sfc
B-Kimura
Ray Hanly
Evan "Radium" Koutsogiannis
James Newman
Justin Ross

Art-
Hugo Neris
Bennascar

robarts
SirHimax

About the Project

Mega Man X Regenesis is a free, open, non-commercial fan project created out of a passion for the Mega Man X series. Following release, the project will be opened to the community so fans can continue building upon and expand the experience together. This game is built on the Godot 4.7 engine solely by Justin Ross.

Mega Man, Mega Man X, and all related characters, names, and trademarks are the property of Capcom. Mega Man X Regenesis is a free, non-commercial fan project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Capcom.
